Nia H: Mateo (new hire) starts Tues 2026-06-01 and hit an I-9 remote exception. Need an in-person verification + badge pickup at SF annex. Can Facilities cover a 9:30 slot? @Ravi

Ravi (Facilities): We have kiosk windows 09:00-12:00. 9:30 works. I can print badge + temp parking pass if People Ops uploads signed form.

newhire-mateo: 9:30 is good. Ill bring a passport and CA license. Is there anything else I should bring?

Nia H: Bring originals of any IDs. Please also complete the quick pre-check form (link sent to your email). If background check asks for address history clarification, upload a short note to the ticket.

Sam (IT): Ill stage the laptop and drop it off with Ravi by 08:45. Ill leave a VPN quickstart.txt on desktop and temp WiFi creds with Facilities.

Tess (Buddy): Ill meet Mateo at reception and run through benefits intro at 10:00 for ~20 mins. Mateo  please expect a short headshot for badge ID.

hr-bot: BG ticket BG-5012: awaiting address confirmation. Deadline in 72 hours to avoid delay. Link: https://redwood.example/hr/bg/5012

newhire-mateo: Uploaded the note and completed the form just now. Thanks everyone.

Ravi (Facilities): Confirmed badge print for 9:30 and parking pass queued. Sam, laptop arrived and labeled.

Nia H: Great! Ill send a calendar invite to the group and mark onboarding checklist as green. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
